name: Aristo
desc:
Aristo is an Etrean NPC. He is a citizen of the [Isle of Vigils](location:isle_of_vigils).

He is usually the first NPC The Pathfinder will talk to. He can help new players figure out where to go when starting out, directly mentioning the island of [Erisia](location:erisia). He can also give 25, which is useful starting out.

He has a counterpart in the [Etris](location:etris) named [Trenti](entity:trenti)
additional_info: -   [Trenti](entity:trenti) and Aristo likely share a hivemind, as you cannot receive 20 notes from both despite them being two distinct NPC's.
